# O — Home page

**Specs:** `home-landing-page` (both scenarios; the Components table is split into built rows and Excluded rows below); the home-related scenario "Banner target does not resolve" of `plp-led-catalog-navigation` is implemented here (its test is listed under N too); imagery per `seed-product-images-pexels` (consumed, not built)
**Depends on:** H, I, N · **Unblocks:** none (generated by verify-plan) · **Decisions:** D-004, D-010, D-011, D-017, D-018, D-050, D-052, D-053, D-055, D-058
**Owner prerequisites:** none for unit tests; OA-02 and OA-03 for the Chrome checks · **Skill refs:** `commercetools-storefront`, `commercetools-platform`

## Goal
`/[locale]` renders the Malva home page of `design/specs/homepage.md`: gradient hero, two promo tiles, "Shop by category" with "From $X/mo" computed from the catalog, and a "Popular add-ons" band. The page is the same for every visitor (static shell + cached catalog sections, revalidated on the catalog TTL); every session-dependent element (account link, bundle count) belongs to the shell (I, M) and is never read here.

## Design

Design source: `design/specs/homepage.md`, `design/DESIGN.md` (components Hero, Promo tile, Category card, Add-on tile), `design/specs/shell.md`. Tokens only (D-053).

### Interfaces O consumes (assumed names; see final report)
| From | Needs | Shape |
| --- | --- | --- |
| H `lib/ct/categories.ts` | `getCategoryTree(locale)` | `Category[]` with `key`, `slug`, `name`, `description`, `orderHint`, `children`, `image: ImageRef \| null` (`ImageRef = { url, alt, photographer }`) |
| H `lib/ct/catalog.ts` | `getCategoryOffers(categoryKey, market, { includeDescendants: true })` (cached) | `Offer[]` as defined in `N-category-listings-and-addons.md` ("Interfaces N consumes") |
| N `lib/listing/*` | `isListable`, `dedupeByAnchors` (`visibility.ts`), `listingKindForCategory` (`kinds.ts`), `categoryHref`, `offerHref` (`links.ts`) | pure |
| H | `formatMoney`, `getLocalizedString`, locale→market mapping (or N's `lib/config/market.ts`) | as H/D define them |
| I | `components/ui/Button`, `Card`; shell (header, footer) in `app/[locale]/layout.tsx` | |

### Static shell, cached sections, per-request slots
| Part | Class | How |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Page frame, hero text, promo tiles, category tiles, add-on tiles | static + cached | One async Server Component `app/[locale]/page.tsx`; data only from H's cached reads; no `cookies()`, `headers()`, session or cart import anywhere under `components/home/**` and `lib/home/**` |
| Page revalidation | ISR | `export const revalidate = 300;` (literal required by Next; a test asserts it equals the catalog TTL constant exported by H's `lib/config/cache.ts`) and `export function generateStaticParams() { return routing.locales.map((locale) => ({ locale })); }`; first line of the component `setRequestLocale(locale)` |
| Header account link ("Log in" / "Hi, Alex") and "My bundle · N" | per-request slots | Owned by the shell (I; count by M's `useCart`, session by E's `useSession`), resolved on the client after load. **Not rendered by the home page.** |
| Anything else session-specific (recently ordered, alerts) | not built | Excluded below |
`npm run build` output must list `/[locale]` as statically generated/ISR (`●`/`○`), not `ƒ`. If it shows `ƒ` because the layout reads cookies, stop and ask (QUESTIONS.md): the shell, not O, must be made static-compatible. O-07 records the build line in the workstream notes.

### Content lives in repo config (answers the spec's first open question)
**Planner default:** hero, promo and tile targets are repo config, not CMS and not custom objects; targeting by Business Unit does not exist (no B2B, D-005) and customer group does not alter the home page.
`lib/config/home.ts`:
```ts
export const HOME_CONFIG = {
  hero: { categoryKey: 'malva-cat-cable-internet' },            // CTA target and image source
  promoTiles: [
    { id: 'phone', tone: 'dark',  categoryKey: 'malva-cat-phone-plans' },   // pink-900
    { id: 'addons', tone: 'light', categoryKey: 'malva-cat-add-ons' },      // brand-100
  ],
  hiddenCategoryKeys: ['malva-cat-devices'] as string[],         // top-level categories not shown as tiles (devices are not designed on the home page)
  popularAddonOfferKeys: [
    'malva-offer-spotify', 'malva-offer-appletv', 'malva-offer-applemusic', 'malva-offer-netflix',
  ] as string[],
  popularAddonCount: 4,
} as const;
```
Copy (en-US/de-DE) is in `messages/*.json` under `home.*`. Category keys are stable (`malva-` keys); slugs are never configured (they are localized and read from the tree).

### Derived values (no price or speed literal in copy; D-018)
`lib/home/derive.ts` (pure, server and test friendly):
- `fromPrice(offers: Offer[]): Money | null` = the **lowest master-variant recurring price** among `dedupeByAnchors(offers.filter(isListable))`; `null` when none has a price (the tile then shows "Browse all →").
- `heroFacts(cableOffers): { speedLabel: string; months: number; price: Money | null }`: `speedLabel` from the max `plan.downstreamMbps` (`>= 1000` → `${n/1000} Gbps` with a trailing `.0` removed, else `${n} Mbps`; de-DE "Gbit/s"/"Mbit/s"); `months` = months of the contract term of the master variant of the cheapest cable offer (`24-months` → 24, `12-months` → 12, month-to-month → 0 and the sentence variant `home.hero.subNoLock` is used); `price` = `fromPrice`.
- `promoPhone(phoneOffers)`: `{ price: fromPrice(phoneOffers) }`. **Planner default:** the prototype copy "Unlimited data from $25 a line" is not true of the data (the $25 plan is 5 GB), so the title is "Plans from {price} a line"; flagged in the final report.
- `popularAddons(addonOffers, keys, count)`: take offers in the order of `keys`, skip (and `console.warn('[home] popular add-on not found', { key })`) any key that is missing, unlisted or without a master price; return at most `count`; the band is hidden when 0 remain. Tile data: `{ key, name, initial, price }` (`initial` = first letter of the name, uppercase).
- `categoryTiles(tree, offersByCategoryKey)`: top-level categories of the tree in tree (`orderHint`) order minus `hiddenCategoryKeys`; each `{ key, slug, name, blurb, kind, fromPrice }`; `blurb` = message `plp.blurb.<category.key>` if it exists (N-13 added the four known keys), else `category.description`, else none; `fromPrice` only when `listingKindForCategory(key) === 'plans'`, otherwise the tile shows "Browse all →". Order with the seed (tree order): Phone plans, Wireless internet, Cable internet, Add-ons; devices hidden.
- `resolveBanner(tree, categoryKey)` → `{ category }` or `null`; on `null`: `console.warn('[home] banner target does not resolve', { categoryKey })` and the banner/promo/CTA is **omitted** (spec scenario "Banner target does not resolve"). Hero without a resolvable target renders without its CTA.

### Components (`components/home/`, owned by O; all Server Components, no client JS)
- `Hero`: container `--container-width`, horizontal padding 40 px; card `--radius-xl`, padding 64 px (mobile 32 px), `--color-brand-gradient`, 2 columns `1.2fr 1fr` gap 40 px (stacked under 768 px, image below text). Eyebrow "New customers" (Exo 600 14, uppercase, 2px tracking); H1 (Exo 700, 56/1.05 → mobile 36); sub (Roboto 18/1.5, max-width 480 px, `{speed}`, `{price}`, `{months}` from `heroFacts`); CTA "See cable plans" → `categoryHref('malva-cat-cable-internet')` as a pill `Link` (`--color-action` bg, `--color-text-on-pink`, Inter 800 16, padding 16×32). Right: 4:3 `HeroImage`.
- `HeroImage` (**answers the open question "banners reuse category images or own search terms"**): **Planner default:** reuse the category image of `HOME_CONFIG.hero.categoryKey` (`Category.image`, seeded from the committed `data/product-images.json`, D-055; no new lock entry, no extra Pexels query). `next/image` `fill`, `sizes="(min-width: 768px) 560px, 100vw"`, `priority`, radius `--radius-lg`, `alt` = `ImageRef.alt` (names the photographer), host must be `images.pexels.com` (allow-list owned by G/A). No image (null) → token-coloured striped placeholder box (`repeating-linear-gradient` with `--color-brand-300`/`--color-brand-400` at 45°), `role="img"`, `aria-label` from `home.hero.imageLabel` ("Hero image placeholder"/"Platzhalter für Hero-Bild"). The footer's Pexels credit link is the shell's (I).
- `PromoTiles`: `repeat(auto-fit, minmax(320px, 1fr))`, gap 24, tile radius `--radius-xl`, padding 36 px. Dark tone: `--color-pink-900`, eyebrow `--color-pink-200`, title white 30/1.15, CTA `--color-brand-500` bg / `--color-brand-950` text. Light tone: `--color-brand-100`, eyebrow `--color-brand-800`, title `--color-text`, CTA `--color-action` / `--color-text-on-pink`. Each CTA links to `categoryHref(tile.categoryKey)`. Tile omitted (and logged) when its category does not resolve.
- `CategoryTiles`: H2 "Shop by category" (36 px); grid `repeat(auto-fit, minmax(260px, 1fr))` gap 24; card (`Link` wrapping): 1px `--color-border`, `--radius-xl`, white, hover `--shadow-md`; honey title band `--color-brand-500` with the name (Exo 700 26, `--color-text-on-brand`); blurb (`--color-text-muted` 16/1.5); line "From $25/mo →" (Exo 600 14, `--color-action`) or "Browse all →". The whole card is the link (`aria-label` = name + from price).
- `PopularAddons`: band `--color-surface-brand-subtle`, vertical padding 56 px; header row H2 "Popular add-ons" + link "View all →" (`categoryHref('malva-cat-add-ons')`); grid `repeat(auto-fit, minmax(200px, 1fr))` gap 16; compact tile = 48 px `--color-pink-900` tile (`--radius-md`, initial letter, `--color-text-on-pink`) + name + "$10/mo"; each tile links to `offerHref(offer)` (the add-on's canonical card on its listing).
- Page order: Hero → PromoTiles → CategoryTiles → PopularAddons. Section gap 24 px (`--space-7`).

`{names}` in the add-on promo = the first two entries of `popularAddons` joined with ", " (en: "Spotify, Apple TV+"; de: "Spotify, Apple TV+").

### SEO
`generateMetadata({ params })`: `title` and `description` from `home.meta.*`; `alternates.canonical = /${locale}`; `alternates.languages = { 'en-US': '/en-US', 'de-DE': '/de-DE' }`; `openGraph.images` = hero category image when present.

### Excluded rows of the spec's Components table (D-005; B2B or not designed)
Header search bar (the search entry is added by P to the shell), cart icon/count and account menu (shell: I, M, E), recently ordered and recommended for you (B2B reorder, not designed), quick order widget (SKU entry, B2B), announcements and system alerts (not designed), personalized and contract-specific promotions, contract expiry and account alerts (excluded for B2C by the spec footer). The two open questions are answered: content owner = repo config; "recently ordered" is not built so it has no company-vs-buyer scope.

### Pitfalls
- Next route segment config must be a literal: do not write `revalidate = TTL`.
- No `cookies()`/`headers()` import in the page or under `components/home/**` (it would silently make the whole page dynamic and let one visitor's state leak into cached HTML). Test O-02 asserts the files do not import `next/headers`, `@/lib/ct/session`, `@/hooks/useCart`.
- Prices come from `Offer.variants[].price` of the **master** variant only (D-011); never from a literal or from the prototype.
- `de-DE` money formatting `39,99 €` comes from `formatMoney`; do not concatenate `€`.
- Promo/hero/category targets are looked up by category **key**, not slug (slugs are localized and editable).
- `next/image` hosts: only `images.pexels.com` and the commercetools image CDN are allowed (seed-product-images-pexels); a category image from another host must not render (fallback to the placeholder).
- A missing category or offer must degrade silently (omit + one `console.warn`), never throw: the home page is the first thing every visitor loads.

## Implementation notes (O-07)
- `npm run build` lists `/[locale]` as `ƒ` (dynamic): the shell's `AccountSlot` (I) reads the session cookie in the layout, which the layout comment already accepts. The page itself reads only cached catalog data. Making it static/ISR needs the shell change (account slot moved to the client), not an O change.
- `revalidate = 60` (the real `CATALOG_TTL`; the plan text said 300).

| Scenario (exact title from the spec) | Capability | Test (file → `it(...)` name) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Anonymous visitor | `home-landing-page` | `app/[locale]/page.test.tsx` → "Anonymous visitor: shared merchandising renders in full and no account-dependent slot exists" |
| Expired session | `home-landing-page` | `app/[locale]/page.test.tsx` → "Expired session: page output is identical and never reads the session or cart" ; `components/home/no-session.test.ts` → "Expired session: home sources import no session or cart module" |
| Banner target does not resolve | `plp-led-catalog-navigation` | `components/home/PromoTiles.test.tsx` → "Banner target does not resolve: banner omitted and omission logged" |

## Manual tests (owner only)
None.

## Excluded
Components rows of `home-landing-page` that are B2B or not designed, with D-005: header search bar (P adds a search entry to the shell), cart icon and item count, account menu (shell), recently ordered and recommended for you, quick order widget, announcements and system alerts, personalized promotions, contract expiry and account alerts. The scenarios "Anonymous visitor" and "Expired session" are built (page never reads the session; the shell resolves identity).
